SUBJ/PROGNOSTIC REASONING FOR TROPICAL CYCLONE 04B (FOUR) WARNING NR 
001//
RMKS/
1. FOR METEOROLOGISTS.
2. 6 HOUR SUMMARY AND ANALYSIS.

SUMMARY:
 INITIAL POSITION: 11.6N 86.6E
 INITIAL INTENSITY: 35 KTS
 GEOGRAPHIC REFERENCE: 668 NM SOUTH OF KOLKATA, INDIA
 MOVEMENT PAST 6 HOURS: WEST-NORTHWESTWARD AT 10 KTS
 SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT: 13 FEET

SATELLITE ANALYSIS, INITIAL POSITION AND INTENSITY DISCUSSION:
ANIMATED MULTISPECTRAL SATELLITE IMAGERY (MSI) DEPICTS TROPICAL 
CYCLONE (TC) 04B WITH A PERSISTENT CENTRAL DENSE OVERCAST (CDO)
OBSCURING THE LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER (LLCC) AND DEVELOPING
CONVECTIVE BANDING ON THE NORTHERN AND SOUTHERN SIDES. A 312225Z
SSMIS 91 GHZ MICROWAVE IMAGE DEPICTS DEEP CONVECTION OFFSET TO THE
NORTHWEST OF THE ASSESSED LLCC. ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS ARE ASSESSED 
AS FAVORABLE WITH LOW (5-10 KTS) VERTICAL WIND SHEAR, WARM (29-30 C) 
SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES, AND STRONG RADIAL AND WESTWARD OUTFLOW 
ALOFT. THE INITIAL POSITION IS ASSESSED WITH LOW CONFIDENCE BASED ON 
THE OBSCURED LLCC. THE INITIAL INTENSITY IS ASSESSED WITH MEDIUM 
CONFIDENCE BASED ON THE AGENCY DVORAK FIXES. THE INITIAL WIND RADII 
ARE ASSESSED WITH LOW CONFIDENCE BASED ON PERSISTENCE FROM A 311736Z 
OSCAT PASS.

INITIAL WIND RADII BASIS: OSCAT DATA

CURRENT STEERING MECHANISM: SUBTROPICAL RIDGE CENTERED TO THE
NORTHEAST

AGENCY DVORAK AND AUTOMATED FIXES: 
 PGTW: T2.5 - 35 KTS
 DEMS: T2.0 - 30 KTS

FORECASTER ASSESSMENT OF CURRENT ENVIRONMENT: FAVORABLE
 VWS: 5-10 KTS
 SST: 29-30 CELSIUS
 OUTFLOW: STRONG RADIAL

ANALYSIS CONFIDENCE:
 INITIAL POSITION: LOW
 INITIAL INTENSITY: MEDIUM
 INITIAL WIND RADII: LOW

3. FORECAST REASONING.

SIGNIFICANT FORECAST CHANGES: THIS INITIAL PROGNOSTIC REASONING
MESSAGE ESTABLISHES THE FORECAST PHILOSOPHY.

FORECAST DISCUSSION: TC 04B IS FORECAST TO TRACK NORTHWESTWARD FOR THE 
ENTIRETY OF THE FORECAST PERIOD UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF A SUBTROPICAL 
RIDGE (STR) CENTERED TO THE NORTHEAST. TRACK SPEED WILL SLOW AS IT 
APPROACHES EASTERN INDIA, WITH LANDFALL EXPECTED TO OCCUR BETWEEN TAUS 
36 AND 48. TRACK SPEED WILL SLOW AS THE SYSTEM INTERACTS WITH THE 
TERRAIN. REGARDING INTENSITY, TC 04B IS EXPECTED TO INTENSIFY OUT TO A 
PEAK OF 50 KTS BETWEEN TAUS 24 AND 36 AS ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS 
REMAIN FAVORABLE AND THE SYSTEM CONTINUES TO CONSOLIDATE. AFTER THIS 
POINT, IT IS EXPECTED TO SHARPLY WEAKEN ONCE IT MAKES LANDFALL AND 
TERRAIN INTERACTION DETERIORATES THE VORTEX. 

MODEL DISCUSSION: TRACK MODEL GUIDANCE IS IN GOOD AGREEMENT THROUGHOUT 
THE FORECAST PERIOD, WITH AN 85 NM CROSS-TRACK SPREAD AT THE TIME OF 
LANDFALL. AFTER LANDFALL, THE MAJORITY OF MODELS SLOW IN TRACK SPEED 
AND DEPICT A SLIGHT WESTWARD TURN. THE OFFICIAL JTWC FORECAST TRACK IS 
ASSESSED WITH HIGH CONFIDENCE, IN GOOD AGREEMENT WITH BOTH THE MULTI-
MODEL AND AI CONSENSUS. INTENSITY MODEL GUIDANCE IS QUITE SPREAD, WITH 
COAMPS-TC, HWRF, AND DECAY-SHIPS DEPICTING PEAKS OF 55 TO 65 KTS AT 
TAU 36 WHILE GFS SHOWS ONLY 40 KTS AT THIS TIME. THE DECAY SHIPS 
MODELS ARE THE SLOWEST TO SHOW DISSIPATION AT TAU 72, WITH THE 
MAJORITY OF MODELS DISSIPATING 04B BY TAU 60. THE FORECAST IS THUS 
EXTENDED OUT TO TAU 72 TO ALLOW FOR THE POSSIBLE SLOWER DISSIPATION AS 
DECAY SHIPS IS SKILLED IN LANDFALL FORECASTS, ALTHOUGH DUE TO ITS 
HIGHER PEAK, THE OFFICIAL JTWC DEPICTS DISSIPATION PRIOR TO TAU 72. A 
RAPID INTENSIFICATION (RI) AID HAS ALSO POPULATED, THOUGH NOT DEPICTED 
IN THE FORECAST. MODELS ARE IN GOOD AGREEMENT ON THE SHARP WEAKENING 
AND DISSIPATION FOLLOWING LANDFALL BUT RETAIN A 20 KT SPREAD DUE TO 
THE DIFFERENT FORECAST PEAKS. THE OFFICIAL JTWC INTENSITY FORECAST IS 
THUS ASSESSED WITH LOW CONFIDENCE, IN GOOD AGREEMENT WITH THE
MULTI-MODEL CONSENSUS.

FORECAST CONFIDENCE:
 TRACK 00-72 HR: HIGH
 INTENSITY 00-72 HR: LOW//
NNNN

IMD.label: IMD (RSMC New Delhi)
IMD.text:
The Depression over Southeast Bay of Bengal moved west-northwestwards with speed of 23 kmph
during past 6 hours, intensified into a deep Depression and lay centered at 0530 hours IST of today,
the 01st November, 2026 over Southeast & adjoining Southwest Bay of Bengal, near Latitude 11.5°N
and Longitude 86.4°E, about 700 km east-southeast of Chennai (Tamil Nadu), 770 km south-southeast
of Vishakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), 770 km southeast of Machilipatnam (Andhra Pradesh) and 810
km east-southeast of Ongole (Andhra Pradesh).
It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify into a Cyclonic Storm over Southwest &
adjoining Westcentral Bay of Bengal during next 6 hours and into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over
Westcentral Bay of Bengal on 2nd November. Continuing to move west-northwestwards, it is very likely
to cross south Andhra Pradesh coast as a Severe Cyclonic Storm with wind speed of 100 to 110 kmph
gusting 120kmph between Nellore and Narsapur by morning of 3rd November 2026.

Rainfall warning:
Coastal Andhra Pradesh: Light to moderate rainfall at many places with heavy rainfall at isolated
places on 1st November. It would increase becoming, light to moderate rainfall at most places with heavy
to very heavy rainfall at a few places and extremely heavy rainfall at isolated places on 2nd & 03rd
November, and heavy rainfall at isolated places on 4th November.
Tamil Nadu: Light to moderate rainfall at many places with heavy rainfall at isolated places on 2nd and
3rd November.
South Odisha: Light to moderate rainfall at many places with heavy rainfall at isolated places on 2nd
November. It would increase becoming light to moderate rainfall at most places with heavy to very heavy
rainfall at isolated places on 3rd & 4th November.
Rayalaseema: Light to moderate rainfall at most places with heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated
places on 2nd and 3rd November.
Telangana: Light to moderate rainfall at many places with heavy rainfall at isolated places on 2nd and
heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places on 3rd November.
Chhattisgarh: Light to moderate rainfall at many places with heavy rainfall at isolated places over
South Chhattisgarh on 2nd and heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places on 3rd November.
